# Thirza Abernethy

[Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society)

## Overview

- **Age:** fifty years of age  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>

- **Family:** [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) (child), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Thirza possesses a tall, slender, and lean frame defined by sharp angles rather than curves. Her dark hair, which is marked with graying and increasingly silvered strands, is kept constantly bound at the back in a tight, firm bun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Thirza Abernethy is a practical, rational, and composed individual who maintains a stern demeanor and an unyielding sense of morality. She refuses on principle to express opinions about ministers, though she is famous in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) for her homemade three-year-old currant wine and her yellow plum preserves reserved specifically for them. Possessing a strict and fault-finding nature alongside the beginnings of a sense of humor, she frequently attaches moral lessons to her words when instructing children. Although reserved in expressing her emotions verbally, she experiences anxiety regarding Nell's spontaneous spirit and cares deeply for her. Over time, her character is noted to have turned mellow.

## History

Thirza Abernethy resided at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where she welcomed an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after an expected boy did not arrive. Though Thirza initially insisted that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) be returned, she reconsidered after visiting a local woman and agreed to keep her, taking on the responsibility of giving the girl a religious upbringing. Thirza proved to be a strict authority figure, scolding Nell's frequent outbursts, demanding formal apologies when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) behaved disrespectfully, and restricting her from wearing flowers to church. However, Thirza slowly softened toward the child; when an amethyst brooch went missing, Thirza mistakenly accused [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of stealing it, but upon discovering it caught in her own shawl, she felt deep remorse and forgave Nell's fabricated confession. Over the following years, Thirza supervised Nell's education, allowing her to study at home during difficult times, providing permission for town trips, and eventually supporting her enrollment in entrance exam preparation. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) earned top marks and attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), Thirza shared the tragic news of a bank failure that precipitated the sudden collapse and death of her brother, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md). Devastated by the loss, Thirza soon learned from an eye doctor that her vision was severely failing, leaving her considering the sale of [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) until [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) relinquished a college scholarship to stay home and care for her.

## Quotes

> "At minimum, provide me with someone native born. A risk will exist, regardless of whom we obtain. Nevertheless, my mind will be more at ease and my night’s sleep will be sounder if we obtain a born Canadian."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)

> "No. A boy is what we need to assist Obed on the farm. To us, a girl would be useless. Remove your hat. On the hall table, I’ll place it along with your bag."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)

> "Now, strip off your clothes as fast as possible and get into bed. In a little while, I’ll return to fetch the candle. Leaving you to extinguish it on your own is too risky. It’s probable you’d burn down the house."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0044)

> "Obed Abernethy, my belief is that you have been enchanted by that child! It is as clear as day to me that your desire is to retain her."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061)

> "Obed Abernethy, my surprise at you is great. Though aware of Nell’s terrible conduct, you still defend her! Next, I expect you will claim that no punishment whatsoever should be given to her!"
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) is a longstanding neighbor and friend of Thirza Abernethy who frequently drops by [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Though [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) expresses strong doubts and curiosity regarding the Abernethys' decisions, Thirza initially defends her family's choices to her. Tensions arise when [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) insults Nell's appearance, leading to a clash that Thirza manages by requiring [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit Agatha's home and deliver a formal apology.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thirza-abernethy.md)

Thirza serves as a strict guardian, mentor, and maternal figure to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after taking the young orphan into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Although Thirza initially intends to send [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back due to a mix-up, she decides to keep her, guiding her religious upbringing, enforcing discipline, and directing her household duties. Despite Thirza's stern exterior and refusal to let [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) call her aunt, a genuine love and close companionship develops between them as Thirza grows increasingly fond of the girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +31 more_

### [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/obed-abernethy--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) is Thirza's brother, and together they reside at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and raise [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). While Thirza initially pushes to return [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to the asylum, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) quietly wants to keep the child, leading them to deliberate and ultimately agree on adopting her. The siblings coordinate household matters and Nell's upbringing, with Thirza confiding her growing affection for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) as his health later begins to fail.

### [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/thirza-abernethy--tranter.md)

Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) is an acquaintance whom Thirza consults regarding the placement and return of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) following the orphan mix-up. Thirza travels to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet with her to resolve the situation, but ultimately decides against passing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to another candidate encountered at Mrs. Tranter's house.
